name: CeraVe Oil Control Moisturizing Gel-Crem
description:
CeraVe Oil Control Moisturizing Gel-Cream is a lightweight moisturizer with oil-absorbing technology and hydrating ingredients that delivers all-day hydration and shine control with a non-greasy, matte finish.

Useable for both men and women.

Made For: Combination to Oily Skin

Helps With: Hydration; Oil Control
